gitCommit.subject: Ops: verify-not-found — a deployed site's 404s, checked from GitHub's network
gitCommit.body:
Ops: verify-not-found — a deployed site's 404s, checked from GitHub's network

scripts/verify-not-found.mjs requests unknown addresses (root, deep, FR, AR,
/account, /admin, /in-app/ in three languages, a query with markup) and known
pages, without following redirects: 404 with the page in the address's
language and frame, noindex, nothing shown back, every referenced file 200;
known pages 200. The workflow runs it on push (default: the site-redesign
preview) or by hand with another origin, and commits its evidence to
ci-evidence under evidence/not-found/. Read only.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01WqJ1WH6TJWfctbXGjyqFZt
